title: Rava son of Rav Avya the Elder
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: “He spoke to Rav Ashi, in Menachot” — so it is cited in Yuchasin, and Yuchasin HaShalem has Rabbah son of Rav Avya the Elder; but Hyman finds neither in the Talmud. Only the Or Zarua HaGadol, Hilkhot Terefot, siman 411, cites from Chullin 47: “Rava son of Rav Avya said to Rav Ashi: All these wild animals have it this way.” Hyman considers that this overturns all of Seder HaDorot’s argument. He proposes a small correction in Yuchasin: “in Chullin” instead of “in Menachot.” See also the entry Rav Avya the Elder.

notes.text: Menachot is a locator in Yuchasin’s report, not something said to Rav Ashi. חיוי ברייתא means wild animals in the saved Davidson Chullin 47a lung-lobe context, not outside snakes. That witness writes Rav Huna Mar bar Avya, while Hyman quotes Rava son of Rav Avya from Or Zarua. His negative observation, proposed locator correction and criticism remain attributed.
